payload.text: Molt 1.4.6 cut (carries issue 0099): dry run clean at 9bfb1a6; book bats lane with devbin-vc, hv runs bin/devbin release v1.4.6; then CI read and END to devbin-vc. After it, kovacs: hv runs molt upgrade from a plain terminal with Claude Code quit; kovacs-sysadm checks only bwrap-userns-restrict of Molt's is in /etc/apparmor.d, both files under /var/lib/molt/apparmor, molt doctor passes, then on hv's go sudo systemctl reset-failed apparmor && sudo systemctl restart apparmor, and sends systemctl status apparmor (0099's owed proof).
